location.selector: option text of the items named in the claim

findings.claim: D7 and GIFT retention, in the restored bytes (main, dd228138): in 3 of 6 items the correct option is the only longest option, so a learner can pick it by length without recalling the idea. The items are 'o2 hidden class', 'o2 protected outside' (correct 'No; outside its package a protected member is reachable only from subclasses', 76 characters), and 'o3 package only'. The C2 checklist (D7) and DESIGN.md's assessment rule require that the correct option is not the longest. The bank this round originally reviewed (dd755970) did not have this cue in these items.
findings.recommendation: When GIFT content may change again (a tooling branch or a test baseline update, since authoring/tests/gift-answer-order.test.mjs pins this bank), shorten each correct option or lengthen one distractor so that the lengths are comparable, then rerun authoring/tools/gift/answer-order.mjs.

items.note: Activity 1 now defines both terms before the code: 'A package groups related classes, like a folder; a file names its package on its first line. An import line lets a class use a class from another package by its short name.' The Activity 3 task names the packages ('package ui', 'package pro'), and the starter begins 'package home;'.

Re-tested headless at 570 px on fresh loads, both with and without the starter's 'package home;' line. 'private int current = 18' without ';' and 'protected int offset = 0' without ';' are each reported at the line that lacks it, with "Add a semicolon (;) at the end of line N" and "This does not count as a try". There is no longer an 'Almost… Keep the field offset' and no longer a wrong line 16. The typo 'pubic int reading()' now gives "<identifier> expected. Java expected a name here: check the spelling of the words on line N". A missing ';' after 'return current' or 't.setTarget(21)' is reported at its own line instead of passing. A correct answer still passes 6 of 6, and a real near-miss (public offset) still gets a specific 'Almost' nudge.

Activity 2's teaching now says 'In the scenarios, shop.Box means class Box in package shop, and b is a Box variable.' The variable 's' in the Thief scenario ('reads s.pin') is still not introduced, but its meaning is clear from the scenario's own 'private int pin; in Safe'.

Open again. artifact.gift is restored to main's bytes (dd228138). 'o1 top-level class' again tests which modifiers a top-level class may take, with feedback about nested classes; the page teaches neither. 'o2 hidden class' again relies on the fully qualified name 'new tools.Helper()' and on 'full name'; the page now teaches import lines but not fully qualified names. 'o2 protected outside' again says Summary 'does not extend Base'; the page never introduces 'extend'.

The table now reads 'only its own package (package access, also called package-private)', which matches objective o1. Members are defined: 'Each field, method and constructor (together, a class's members)'. The private row now reads 'only inside its own class', without 'top-level'.

The decision is now the two-way 'Keep this member private, or open it wider?' and 'Use it when:' is now a situation: 'Only the class's own methods use the member, such as a stored value or a helper.' The boundary still names only the other-package case ('make it public'). That is a fair answer to a private-or-wider choice, and the table above covers the narrower levels.

Hint 2 now reads 'For each one, ask two questions about its caller: is it in the same package, and is it a subclass? Then read the table from the bottom up and stop at the first row whose Usable from covers that caller.' This is a reasoning step that no longer describes the answer level.

Deferred to a tooling branch by reconciliation. artifact.md is still identical to md-from-html.mjs output and still has no On the job card or task leads. It still has the '## Model' heading, hints under '## Cheat sheet', and a flattened starter.
Wrong lane presses now read 'Not this lane (“Compiles”). Without a modifier, size is invisible outside package shop.' (observed at 570 px).
At 570 px the first table column now shows 'protected' on one line (nowrap on that column's code). The page does not scroll horizontally (scrollWidth 570 px).
The completion recap now names 'Decide who can use a member', 'Open a thermostat's members just enough' and 'Pick the narrowest modifier', matching the lesson path (observed).
